generation.native_output_limit_note: The unchanged pinned CLI declares 64k per call; the API review phases have 96k allowances. These are distinct runtime ceilings, not matched realized effort.
generation.agentic_attempt_deadline_basis: 10800 s (three hours, three API phase deadlines) per native attempt, registered after the v10r CHORUS attempt stopped at the previously hardcoded 1800 s in Phase 3 (#2010, #2015). A wall-clock control only; the sequence ledger remains the only cost bound.
generation.native_cap_basis: No per-attempt cap on the agentic arm, by user direction (2026-09-16): the v10q attempt stopped at $10 after chunk review and the full record (#1917), and the remaining phases are unmeasured. Each agentic attempt is bounded by the additional allocation through the sequence ledger; every request is still counted and reserved before it is sent.

schema_release.basis: Full and core declare 3.0.0; every model-facing study string left the generation schemas; neither profile digest md5 moved; the entry points, merged files and edited modules did. Registered before this condition; see notes/schema_release_3.0.0_2026-09-16.md.

generation.source_review_protocol: renderer14 / evidence_assertions v3 / source_review v1; explicit audit record/artifact namespaces; whole-record audit and final report; unchanged phase-scoped native checker history
generation.source_review_acceptance: Coverage and declared attribution/status consistency do not establish semantic entailment. Independent unchanged-source acceptance is required. Failed/unusable API source reviews stop before repair/retry and refuse resume. Native Phase 1 receipt/full-draft corrections are permitted before core derivation, provided the strict receipt gate passes for the current unchanged full/receipt before the first core derivation. A Phase 1 full/receipt write invalidates that first-derivation gate. Registered later reconciliation retains its own checks. Failed terminal evidence/source-review checks in Phases 3/4 stop; current-file success cannot erase those failures. Inspect registered native_phase_history plus actual checker results, helper arguments and original-freeze chronology. No operator post-run repair of measured artifacts or rewriting rejected/frozen evidence after a terminal failure. Registered in-run reconciliation remains permitted before any terminal failure. #2079 remains open: independent acceptance must review literal variable identifiers versus broad data categories, dates/scopes/bounds before asserting count disagreement, shared prose in both full and core contexts, and consistent prospective-versus-observed status. These are reviewer checks, not completed acceptance or a claim that #2079 is resolved.

canary_order_basis.basis: User explicitly reaffirmed native first on 2026-09-17; preserve the existing order independently of the new single-canary authorization.
canary_order_basis.acceptance: Accept every earlier unchanged canary independently before admitting the next.

native_denial_policy.ruling: denied prescribed command disqualifies a run, while denials of forbidden commands are listed and do not disqualify it on their own.
native_denial_policy.enforcement: Policy version 4 and control contract 2 admit Bash, Read and Write before execution. Reads are restricted to registered inputs, this job output files and unchanged runtime-persisted results with observed provenance; writes are restricted to this job outputs. Missing, malformed or timed-out decisions stop the controller. Denied prescribed or unclassifiable calls disqualify; unprescribed denials are listed. Terminal review reconciles calls, callbacks, decisions and results. Helper arguments, phase order and scientific claims still need independent review; this is not a filesystem sandbox.

native_controls.basis: Unchanged from v10x: policy v4 / control contract v2 file admission, matching deadline and denial controls, safe local terminal diagnostics, and #2067 phase-aware checker-history review remain pinned.
